name: nimbus
description: NIMBUS — Newell Integrated Batch & Unified Scheduling. Static frontend with no runtime bundler; this package.json backs the ESLint static-analysis gate and a per-file (non-bundling) TypeScript build for modules that have been migrated — see docs/archive/typescript_migration.md.

scripts.lint: eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern web/app.js web/nimbus-intelligence.js web/nimbus-compute-core.js web/locales "web/**/*.mjs" "web/**/*.mts" "web/**/*.d.ts" web/nimbus-worker.ts scripts tests/modules
scripts.lint:errors: eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern web/app.js web/nimbus-intelligence.js web/nimbus-compute-core.js web/locales "web/**/*.mts" "web/**/*.d.ts" web/nimbus-worker.ts --quiet
scripts.lint:ci: eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern web/app.js web/nimbus-intelligence.js web/nimbus-compute-core.js "web/**/*.mjs" "web/**/*.mts" "web/**/*.d.ts" web/nimbus-worker.ts scripts tests/modules --quiet
scripts.test: npm run test:legacy && npm run test:modules
scripts.generate:api-types: python scripts/dump_openapi.py > web/types/.openapi-schema.json && openapi-typescript web/types/.openapi-schema.json -o web/types/api-generated.d.mts
